claims.claim: Last Mile is an independent physical operations platform and orchestration layer designed to connect operating conditions, coordinated work, and verified physical outcomes.
The platform model comprises Infinit-Signal, Singularity, Infinit-Flow, and Infinit-Control.
Operational records are created once as canonical records and consumed through governed product contracts.
Consequential physical actions remain governed by customer policy and human authority.
Recovery is evaluated from return telemetry and operating evidence rather than ticket closure alone.
Reference implementation planning pages may present phased rollout models, staffing estimates, and parallel-run governance as planning aids rather than customer commitments.
Last Mile Synapse is the implementation label for the open-protocol edge gateway workstream that stages source acquisition for Infinit-Signal during rollout.
